The property asserts `publishTgeDetails` must:
1. Only set `askToken` when it is currently `address(0)` (one-time-set invariant)

Enforcement mechanism check (lines 255–278): the function has modifiers `onlyLegion`, `whenNotPaused`, `whenSaleNotCanceled`, `whenSaleEnded`, `whenRefundPeriodIsOver` — none of which address the two required invariants. - Guard for "non-zero input": no `require(askToken != address(0))` or any zero-address revert. Compared with `LegionTokenDistributor.sol` which does check `_tokenDistributorInitParams.askToken == address(0)` (line 338).

Proof **fails** at both conditions: neither guard exists.
